commits.message:
docs: add cost rationale reference page with sourced resource explanations

Create a shared conceptual page (docs/cost_rationale.md) explaining Soroban's
metered resources and which operations dominate, written for contract developers.

- Explains budgets/limits, CPU instructions, memory, storage (ledger entry
  accesses + I/O bytes), transaction size, events, and space rent
- Cites Stellar documentation (fees-resource-limits-metering, ContractCostType)
- Links measured figures from soroban-budget-assert mechanics.md without copying
- Ranks operations by cost impact (storage writes > reads > host calls > Wasm)
- Documents the local-vs-network measurement gap with the raw table from the
  sibling repo
- Adds per-lint resource target summary table
- Includes explicit 'What We Don't Yet Know' section — no invented numbers
- Wires into SUMMARY.md under a new 'Concepts' section
- Updates each lint page with target resource annotation and link to the
  cost rationale page
- Updates lints/README.md with a Target Resource column

Refs: #121
